living_area_thresholds.note: Fallback values from config/filters.json. At runtime, _score_living_area reads filter_config.living_area_min as floor; cap = floor + 100 when no max is configured.

rooms_thresholds.note: Fallback values from config/filters.json.bedrooms_min. At runtime, _score_rooms uses filter_config.bedrooms_min as floor; cap = max(8, floor + 4).
